notes.title: Game Update v5.0.0
notes.content: We've just updated the game to the latest version of the HexWar Engine. This includes various bug fixes and performance improvements!

notes.title: Ancient Battle: Rome - version 3.0.4 update
notes.content: Change: The bonus 'Graecia' Campaign is now available to all players without requiring an email registration.

notes.title: Ancient Battle: Rome Version 3.0.3 Update
notes.content: Fix: Some sound effects not playing following the last update.

notes.title: Ancient Battle: Rome v3.0.2 Update
notes.content:
Change: Improved A.I. opponent.
 Change: Improved game logic for advance after combat. Unit will more often advance after combat if the target hex has been vacated.
 Change: Play balance in the Stour River mission.
 Change: Play balance in the 'Nicopolis' battle.
 Change: Play balance in the 'Camp Siege' battle.
 Change: Play balance in 'Alesia'. After some A.I. improvements the game was a little too hard as Gaul.
 Fix: An issue with some background image not always appearing in the victory displays.
 Fix: Sometimes the game was not ending correctly in the 'Utica' mission.
 Fix: Sometimes the game was not ending correctly in the 'Survival' mission.
 Fix: Sometimes the victory medals did not appear in the campaign windows.
 Fix: Some screen layout issues.
 Fix: Some projectile animations not displaying.
 Fix: Invalid font selection on some buttons on some platforms.
 Update: Source material credits.

notes.title: Friends, Romans, countrymen, ready your spears! Ancient Battle Rome update has arrived!
notes.content:
We’re pleased to announce that the first update to Ancient Battle Rome has arrived!  This update includes general improvements and fixes to problem scenarios.

Fix issue with missing and unselectable Generals.
Fix incorrect How-To images.
Add missing section to Terrain Chart.
Add tooltips to map overlay.
Improve appearance of UI.

We hope everyone is enjoying the game, but if anyone has any issues, please let us know at support@hexwar.com.

~The HexWar Games Team.
